hints.title: Locked Elements Invariant
hints.text: Locked elements at indices where locked[i] == 1 cannot be swapped. If any locked element does not match its sorted target position, sorting is impossible.

hints.title: Unlocked Cycles and Swaps
hints.text: Unlocked positions form components within which elements can be rearranged freely if distance constraints allow.

hints.title: Cycle Decomposition
hints.text: Count the number of displacement cycles among unlocked elements to determine minimum transposition operations.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Cycle decomposition on permutation graph with locked constraints.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating individual swaps step-by-step is quadratic.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies locked mismatch impossibility immediately, then counts permutation cycles.
